title: French-Style Chorizo Tagine
description: A fusion of French and Moroccan flavors, this hearty tagine features spicy chorizo sausage and tender vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in the tagine over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced chorizo and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onions and minced garlic, cooking until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes, chickpeas, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 20 minutes.
Optional: add the Norwegian salmon fillets to the tagine for the last 10 minutes of cooking.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
Serve with crusty bread or couscous for a filling meal.
